steps.en: Install the skill into your agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进你的 agent

steps.en: Start a long task and let the skill write the plan
steps.zh: 开一个长任务，让 skill 写下计划

steps.en: Keeps state in three files on disk
steps.zh: 把状态放进磁盘上的三个文件

steps.en: Re-injects the active plan into the window every turn
steps.zh: 每回合把当前计划重新注进窗口

steps.en: Let the context die — /clear, compaction, crash
steps.zh: 放任上下文死掉——/clear、压缩、崩溃

steps.en: Gated mode holds the stop while any phase is in_progress
steps.zh: gated 模式下，只要还有阶段在做就不让停

value.en: The plan outlives every context reset; done means the on-disk checkboxes say so, not the model's confidence
value.zh: 计划熬过每次上下文重置，“做完没”由盘上的勾选框说了算，而不是模型自信
